summary_ja: 内部格付手法採用最終指定親会社が申請事項の変更や最低要件を満たさない事由の発生を届け出る義務と、改善計画等の提出を定める。
summary_en: Requires a company adopting the internal ratings-based approach to notify changes to the application and any failure to meet the minimum requirements, and to submit an improvement plan or a materiality explanation.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall, where any of the following items applies, notify the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency of that fact and its details without delay. (i) Where there is a change in the matters stated in the application for approval. (ii) Where there is a material change in the matters stated in the documents attached to the application for approval. (iii) Where a circumstance has arisen in which the minimum requirements provided in Subsections 1 through 8 of Section 4 are not satisfied.

Where a circumstance listed in item (iii) of the preceding paragraph has arisen, the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall promptly submit either a document stating an improvement plan for that circumstance or a document stating an explanation that the circumstance is not material from the viewpoint of the risk of that Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc.
